columns.completion_tokens_*: engine-reported completion tokens over rows where known (n_known next to it)
columns.extraction_<status>: protocol extraction status counts (resolved, ambiguous, invalid, excluded)
columns.extraction_failure_rate: not reported: no deterministic extraction-failure measure applies across the suite (on several routes the value is the raw response by design); use the sentinel, the markers and the length_stop_* cross-tab
columns.extraction_status_not_resolved_rate: share of rows whose protocol status is not 'resolved'. This is the exporter's status, not an answer-extraction failure measure: truncated or unparseable responses are usually 'resolved' with the raw text as value
columns.extraction_value_is_response_rate: share of rows whose extracted value equals the (stripped) response: the official scorer parses the response itself. Normal on the benchmark_adapter route, so not a failure measure
columns.finish_reason_*: recorded finish reasons; length_stop_rate = length / rows with a known finish reason
columns.judge_incomplete_sentinel_rows: rows whose extracted value starts with the judge's 'The model response is incomplete / does not ...' statement (deterministic sentinel of no answer)
columns.length_stop_judge_incomplete_sentinel: length-stopped rows whose extracted value is the judge's 'incomplete' statement
columns.length_stop_marker_any_final: length-stopped rows that still contain a final-answer marker
columns.length_stop_score_available / _score_zer: length-stopped rows with an official row score / scored 0
columns.length_stop_value_is_response: length-stopped rows whose extracted value is the raw response
columns.marker_*_rate: deterministic final-answer markers over rows with known text (presence only)
columns.n_tokens_at_or_above_cap: rows whose completion tokens reach max_tokens; NOT a length stop by itself
columns.row_scorer_judge_rows / row_scorer_known: local runs: rows scored by a judge-backed scorer (scorer name matches judge/qwen3) / rows with a recorded scorer; null for the archive, which does not record per-row scorers
columns.scoring_route / score_contract_names_jud: suite scoring route, and whether the suite score contract or benchmark provenance names a judge (judge-backed official scoring the used_judge flag may not show)
columns.used_judge_rate: export's extraction used_judge flag over rows where known
